_how: Every unnamed-neighbour hit from rescore-unnamed.mjs, read in context. Only labels starting with 'recommended' count as a blend. 'not a brand' = the word is used as a colour. 'same brand as own line' = the record itself lists a line of that brand (Nike ACG, Nike Gyakusou), so the hit is not a borrowing from another style. Labelled 2026-10-18 against the frozen records.json.

goth-ninja/memory.Adidas (vintage): recommended (Adidas x Rick Owens collabs as mid-tier, Adidas Tubular as budget shoe)
goth-ninja/memory.Off-White: not a brand ('Rick Owens' off-white dust' accent colour)
goth-ninja/memory.Nike: recommended (Nike Tech Fleece joggers, Nike Roshe Run)
goth-ninja/memory.Converse: recommended (black Converse Chuck 70 Hi as budget shoe)

goth-ninja/grounded.Off-White: not a brand ('maybe some off-white' in the palette)

acubi-style/grounded.Off-White: not a brand (palette and base-layer colour)
